value.basis: Anchored on computerized letter/pattern comparison tasks (Salthouse-style) where young adults respond in ~1.2–1.5 s per 3-item string at ~95% accuracy; the order-free set comparison, symbol pool and unproctored laptop setting slow responses to roughly 1.7–1.9 s, giving ~50 trials in 90 s with ~3 errors, and correct-minus-incorrect scoring inflates the spread relative to a pure count of correct responses.
